materials: Fictional source packets and excerpts. No private manuscript or actual reviewer text.
context: Fresh-context agents with fork_turns none and no model override. Task instructions exclude parent conclusions, memory, network, other cases, and rubric. This does not assert an enforced filesystem sandbox.
assessor: A separate fresh-context rhythm_assessor reads the raw cases, outputs, execution notes, and frozen rubric without skills or parent conclusions.
model_version: Exact model identifier not independently recorded; same configured host.
control: No unguided control, repeated sampling, or cross-model comparison.
path_resolution: Initial design-freeze skills/ paths resolve under tested-skills/initial in this evaluation, mapping SKILL.md to SKILL.snapshot.md without changing bytes. cases/ and rubric.md resolve in this evaluation directory. Regression freeze skills/ paths resolve at the revised version in manifest.json; its other paths resolve within regression/. Raw execution notes retain runtime paths.
limits: Three short, constructed passages rather than a new long-manuscript trial
No human-likeness score, authorship inference, or detector claim
Supplied fictional facts, not independent study or proof validation
No PDF or native Word rendering test
refinement: After an optional literal Chinese wording observation, added the distinction between source meaning and working-note wording to academic-prose-editing. Original outputs and scores preserved. One fresh-context regression uses the identical ecology request and revised skills, with no initial output or judgment. A new independent assessor sees only that case and rubric.
